verdict.rationale: Parahelp documents gap-finding for live performance: on-demand reports on where the Customer Agent falls short, and scheduled automations that watch the support queue and surface gaps. Fixes flow back as reviewed, versioned, revertable releases with impact tracking, and simulations can replay historical tickets to check a change. Missing for 10: explicit scoring of sampled AI conversations, per-conversation failure flagging and a QA review queue, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
